name: Martha
summary: A woman of Bethany, sister of Mary and Lazarus, whom Jesus loved. She welcomed Jesus into her house, and when Lazarus died she told Jesus she believed He was the Christ.

key_moments.title: Asks Jesus to Send Mary to Help
key_moments.description: Martha welcomed Jesus into her house while her sister Mary sat at His feet listening. Martha was busy serving and asked Jesus to make Mary help, but He said Mary had chosen the good part.

key_moments.title: Says She Believes Jesus Is the Christ
key_moments.description: When Lazarus had died, Martha went out to meet Jesus and said her brother would not have died if He had been there. Jesus said He is the resurrection and the life, and Martha said she believed He was the Christ, God's Son.

key_moments.title: Sees Lazarus Called from the Grave
key_moments.description: At the tomb, Martha warned that Lazarus had been dead four days. Jesus told her that if she believed she would see God's glory, then He called Lazarus out of the grave.

key_moments.title: Serving at the Supper
key_moments.description: Six days before the passover, a supper was made for Jesus in Bethany. Martha served, and Lazarus sat at the table with Him.
